parameters.help_en:
The ID of the remediation setting.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a remediation setting, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270772.html
parameters.help_zh:
修正设置ID。

关于如何获取修正设置ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270772.html
parameters.name: remediation_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the remediation. Valid values:

OOS: Operation Orchestration Service (template-based remediation).

FC: Function Compute (custom remediation)
parameters.help_zh:
修正类型。取值：
OOS：运维编排（模板修正）。
FC：函数计算（自定义修正）
parameters.name: remediation_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the remediation template.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a remediation template, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270066.html
parameters.help_zh:
修正模板ID。

关于如何获取修正模板ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270066.html
parameters.name: remediation_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode of the remediation. Valid values:

NON_EXECUTION: The remediation is not executed.

AUTO_EXECUTION: The remediation is automatically executed.

MANUAL_EXECUTION: The remediation is manually executed.

NOT_CONFIG: The execution mode is not specified
parameters.help_zh:
修正执行方式。取值：
NON_EXECUTION：不执行。
AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。
MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。
NOT_CONFIG：未设置
parameters.name: invoke_type

parameters.help_en:
The source of the remediation. Valid values:

ALIYUN: official remediation.

CUSTOM: custom remediation.

NONE: none
parameters.help_zh:
执行修正来源。取值：
ALIYUN：官方修正。

CUSTOM：自定义修正。

NONE：无
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The parameters of the remediation setting
parameters.name: params

parameters.help_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a token that is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token
